document: Hungarian general terms and conditions (ÁSZF) of a seller or service provider
glossary: Document type: Hungarian general terms and conditions (ÁSZF) of a seller or service provider. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document (A dokumentum cime/megnevezese, ahogy a lapon szerepel (pl. Altalanos Szerzodesi Feltetelek, ASZF, Terms and Conditions))
field_specs.seller_name: the seller name as printed on the document
field_specs.seller_address: the seller address as printed on the document (Az Elado szekhelye/cime, ha szerepel)
field_specs.seller_registration_number: the seller registration number as printed on the document (Az Elado cegjegyzekszama/nyilvantartasi szama (cegjegyzekszam, ICO, registration no.), ha szerepel)
field_specs.effective_date: the effective date as printed on the document (Az ASZF hatalybalepesenek/kiadasanak/utolso modositasanak datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, ha szerepel)
field_specs.page_count: the page count as printed on the document (A dokumentum osszes oldalszama, ha lathato (pl. "1/35" oldaljeloles -> 35))
